title: --scope user does not create ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md while ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md exists, and warns; an existing ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md still gets the block
source: intended: owner decision (v0.3): OpenCode reads ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md only while its own AGENTS.md is absent, so jitso does not create that file beside it
intent: INTENDED behavior (setup instructions writes AGENTS.md only). The home has a `~/.config/opencode` folder without `AGENTS.md`, a `~/.pi/agent` folder and a `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`. OpenCode falls back to `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` only while `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` is absent, so creating it would hide the user's rules from OpenCode. `--scope user --yes` creates `~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md`, creates no `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md`, leaves `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` byte for byte and warns `jitso: warning: ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md was not created, because OpenCode reads ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md only while it is absent; create it yourself (it may import your rules) and run again`. Once the user has created that file, the next run appends the block to it, with no warning.

stderr.equals: jitso: warning: ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md was not created, because OpenCode reads ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md only while it is absent; create it yourself (it may import your rules) and run again
